definition: Software technology that automates repetitive, rule-based digital tasks by mimicking the actions a human would take within software applications.
details: RPA is often distinguished from more flexible AI agent systems by its reliance on predefined, rule-based scripts rather than adaptive reasoning, though modern platforms increasingly blend RPA with AI capabilities.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Think of it this way: Software technology that automates repetitive, rule-based digital tasks by mimicking the actions a human would take within software applications. And here is the clever part: RPA is often distinguished from more flexible AI agent systems by its reliance on predefined, rule-based scripts rather than adaptive reasoning, though modern platforms increasingly blend RPA with AI capabilities. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Robotic Process Automation — a small key that opens a big door.
